6. What Did Happen When Father Matilda Left The Promised Land?
Doctor Who has really given Patrick, Jo's son, almost as much to do as his mum, and he has yet another solo scene in "Kerblam!" And when his mother is onscreen, he stays firmly out of the way. It’s a subtle tribute to the character’s separation from the other cast members, bringing attention to the sad reasons for her departure from Coral Blue.
